implementation.scope: shared render-only live-water presentation on the three strongest solver-accepted interior breaking sites
implementation.site_authority: strict local supercritical-to-subcritical Froude transitions, sorted by solver-derived intensity and filtered for full presentation coverage, 15 m edge clearance, and 6 m deduplication
implementation.shape: compact dark plunge core at 1.8 m downstream, irregular broken shoulders near 3.0 m lateral offset, and an aerated return centered 5.0 m downstream
implementation.foam_combination: maximum-combined with the existing solver foam source
implementation.normal_update: only vertices in or immediately adjacent to a modified pocket are recomputed

contracts: dark plunge core stays inside the 0.28 m per-site depression bound
downstream return rises and produces stronger foam than the plunge core
broken side shoulder produces bounded lift and foam
zero intensity produces zero presentation displacement and foam

accepted_warnings: the offline generate_204 connectivity timeout while loading Zambezi

visual_evidence.method: Two 1280x720 offscreen Metal captures review the current runtime at the exact retained fixed camera and the solver-selected breaking_water_side preset. Metrics are descriptive and are not photoreal acceptance thresholds.

descriptive_comparison.interpretation: The similar delta in unrelated upper background and animated water proves that these captures do not provide deterministic pixel attribution for the small geometry change; no improvement percentage is claimed.

close_side.finding: The bounded depression and return read as a shallow coherent trough with broken shoulders. The frame shows no dome, tent, rail, translucent card, or new shoreline intersection artifact.

visual_evidence.retention_basis: The implementation has explicit geometry and authority bounds, its focused contracts and complete runnable-map matrix pass, and direct side review finds no manufactured-water artifact. The evidence does not prove lifelike Zambezi whitewater, so the candidate is retained only as technical progress.

remaining_photoreal_defects: The strongest rapid still lacks a convincing volumetric entrained-air body, deep aerated hole, coherent recirculation, and collision-aware spray and mist.
The bounded pocket is a deterministic render profile attached to solver-selected transitions, not a validated free-surface hydraulic simulation.
The sampled water and procedural bathymetry remain too low resolution to reproduce rapid-specific Zambezi tongues, boils, lateral waves, rocks, and seasonal changes.
The animated water/material capture path is not frame-deterministic, so matched image deltas cannot isolate small geometry changes without a frozen presentation clock.
The 30 m source terrain, synthetic ground cover, hard waterline transitions, and sparse near-field geology remain visibly procedural.
Raft, equipment, character animation, paddle contact, and final foam/crew occlusion still require named lifelike art acceptance.
A target-hardware GPU profile and named multi-discipline art review have not accepted the combined terrain, water, VFX, raft, and crew presentation.
